name: ziviSynthi AKS: An Open-Source Pin-Matrix Synthesizer Firmware Inspired by the EMS Synthi AKS
description: ziviSynthi AKS is an independent research instrument for digital lutherie and embedded music computing. Inspired by the EMS Synthi AKS, it pairs a 16 × 16 signal and modulation matrix with a C synthesis engine for the M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro and a bilingual Web Studio for browser synthesis, patch editing and communication over USB MIDI.

affiliation.name: Universidade Federal do Recôncavo da Bahia

softwareRequirements: M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro for the Felucca firmware. The Web Studio Try mode runs in the browser without the controller.
